verses.text: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do (Meaning the soldiers who crucified him,) and they parted his raiment and cast lots.

title: JST, Luke 23:35. Compare Luke 23:34 Jesus asks forgiveness for the Roman soldiers who are crucifying Him.
